verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a cloud SaaS that stores digitized mail, but the evidence never documents any choice of storage region for that data. Choosing one of 53 U.S. street addresses selects a mailing location, not where scans and account data are stored, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit. Generic cloud-storage and encryption claims also say nothing about region selection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
